channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Underwater Horrors
item.description: Adds nightmare sea monsters to Vintage Story (Sea Serpents, Kraken)

item.title: VS Hex Casting
item.description: A port of Hexcasting from Minecraft to Vintagestory

item.title: Landships: Type95 & Grosstraktor
item.description: Ands a drivable, functional Char 2C super-heavy tank to the game.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Vanilla Values
item.description: An optional add-on mod that changes Fauna of the Stone Age animal drops to Vanilla Values

item.title: Better Pyrolysis
item.description: Adds several new features regarding pyrolyzing different fuels in coke ovens.

item.title: Surface Teleporter - Extra Jonas Devices
item.description: A reusable teleporter that sends you upward when used, either to the surface or high into the sky.

item.title: Drifters Don't Spawn in Rooms
item.description: A mod that adds configurability to Vintage Story rooms, like preventing drifter spawns

item.title: Achievements
item.description: Adds vanilla, lore, AllClasses, Hod and Primitive Survival Achievements and random rewards

item.title: 1.23 Backport
item.description: Backports some things from 1.23 to 1.22 for servers that cannot update.

item.title: Soul Gears
item.description: A craftable gear similar to a Temporal Gear that gives you one charge of KeepInventory when used.

item.title: Djuradj's Tweaks
item.description: Small batch of tweaks and patches specifically intended for my private server.

item.title: Temporal Storms Require a Fight
item.description: Temporal Storms are more severe but reduced by killing drifters!

item.title: Oversized Horrors
item.description: Massive versions of normal VS enemies

item.title: Spreading Devastation
item.description: This mod allows you to create spreading devastation, akin to Thaumcraft taint or Terraria Corruption

item.title: Livestock Welfare
item.description: Animals that age, get dirty and sick, and need shelter and water. Groom, pet and care for them.

item.title: Rustfall
item.description: A huge overhaul mod that adds new custom lore and worldtype. The core of the Rustfall modpack

item.title: GhostChunks
item.description: Highly performant distant terrain LOD renderer, capable of rendering at 200+ fps! Now w/Komet Compat

item.title: Seraph Leveling
item.description: Level-up and gain traits in a vanilla friendly way

item.title: Cocktail Madness!
item.description: Allows for the mixing of alcoholic and non alcoholic beverages.

item.title: Seraph Living Survival Simulation
item.description: A simple survival simulation mod

item.title: The Shattered Heart Core Server Mod
item.description: Cross-mod compatibility fixes for The Shattered Heart modpack — patches join-crashes & gaps.

item.title: FooAlterations
item.description: Tweaks for server

item.title: Full Block Road
item.description: Client-side: the stone road gets a full-block collision box

item.title: Opttage Visual
item.description: Terrain appears sooner: faster chunk loading on the client, optional smarter chunk sending on server

item.title: Serverfixes for Miraserver
item.description: My personal server fixes for small issues and errors

item.title: Content Tester for Mira Server
item.description: Just some content testing for my personal server

item.title: Gentage
item.description: Heritable genetics for vanilla animals: traits improve or worsen each generation

item.title: Wulk's Smithing Addons
item.description: Adds in new models for anvils, tools and new types of metal (mostly steels)

item.title: Aegis Horizons
item.description: Distant terrain for Aegis Terrain worlds.

item.title: Aegis Claims
item.description: Chunk claims for civilization servers, with nations, player towns, capitals and an admin painter on
